# nbview

> nbview is a free, open-source Jupyter notebook viewer for public GitHub repos, gists and direct .ipynb links. Notebooks are fetched and rendered in the reader's browser; there is no nbview server that sees them. It is an independent alternative to nbviewer, not affiliated with Project Jupyter.

## How to link to a notebook

- GitHub notebook: https://nbview.org/github/{owner}/{repo}/blob/{branch}/{path}.ipynb
- GitHub repo or folder: https://nbview.org/github/{owner}/{repo}
- Gist: https://nbview.org/gist/{user}/{id}
- Any direct .ipynb URL that allows cross-origin reads: https://nbview.org/#/url/{url}
- Replace nbviewer.org with nbview.org in an existing nbviewer link and it works.
- Add ?cell=N to a notebook link to open it scrolled to cell N.

## Docs

- [Home page and viewer](https://nbview.org/): paste a repo, notebook link or gist
- [README](https://github.com/chizkidd/nbview#readme): features, limits and privacy
- [Changelog](https://github.com/chizkidd/nbview/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): what changed in each release
- [Security policy](https://nbview.org/.well-known/security.txt): how to report a problem

## Notes for automated agents

- The viewer is a client-side app. Notebook content only exists after JavaScript runs in a browser, so a plain HTTP fetch of a nbview.org link returns the app shell, not the notebook. To read a notebook's contents, fetch the raw .ipynb from GitHub (raw.githubusercontent.com) instead.
- Source code (MIT license): https://github.com/chizkidd/nbview
